ARTIFACT_LORE_PATTERNS.template: Crafted by the first artisans of the {culture}, blessed by hands that knew the old ways
Won in battle when the {culture} stood against the tide and refused to break
Born in the dreaming hours when the {culture}'s seers walked between worlds
Devised by {culture} necessity, when survival demanded invention over tradition
Passed down through {culture} generations, each holder marked by its dark purpose
Forged from the sacrifice of a {culture} hero who gave everything for their people

FACTION_VOICE_BIBLE.tagline: Streetwise, sardonic, pragmatic. The guild is a ledger. Honor is whatever keeps the ledger balanced.
Scholarly, obsessive, half in love with the thing that could kill them.
Dutiful, measured, institutional. The city has made a promise and the guard is the promise.
The faithful do not admit doubt. When the prose admits doubt, it shows it in the weather — a cloud across the sun, a candle guttering.
Regal, intrigue-laden, old. The Court speaks as if every conversation has been happening for a hundred years.
Practical, craft-focused, quietly proud. The Fellowship's prose does not moralize — it measures.
Terse, observant, the prose reads as if written by someone on watch.
Calculating, civil, precise. The Consortium smiles at you and takes a small, clean bite.
Blunt, professional, darkly funny. Mercenaries do the work and want to be paid.
Quiet, precise, patient. The Covenant knows the world forgets and considers that a personal affront.
Mystic, layered, careful. The Temple holds all nine spheres and weighs them against each other constantly.

FACTIONS.name: The Thieves Guild
FACTIONS.motto: What the eye does not see, the heart does not grieve.

FACTIONS.name: The Temple of the Spheres
FACTIONS.motto: In devotion, all spheres are one.

FACTIONS.name: The Arcane Circle
FACTIONS.motto: Knowledge is the only true power.

FACTIONS.name: The Rangers Brotherhood
FACTIONS.motto: We walk so others need not.

FACTIONS.name: The Underking's Court
FACTIONS.motto: Every throne casts a shadow. Ours is the deeper.

FACTIONS.name: The Holy Order of the Dawn
FACTIONS.motto: By blade and prayer, darkness is undone.

FACTIONS.name: The Lorekeepers Covenant
FACTIONS.motto: To forget is to lose. To record is to endure.

AGENT_CONDITIONS.name: Wounded
AGENT_CONDITIONS.description: Suffering from injuries sustained in conflict. Combat effectiveness reduced.

AGENT_CONDITIONS.name: Inspired
AGENT_CONDITIONS.description: Buoyed by a triumph of the spirit. Social and creative endeavors flourish.

AGENT_CONDITIONS.name: Terrified
AGENT_CONDITIONS.description: Gripped by fear from a harrowing encounter. Avoids danger at all costs.

AGENT_CONDITIONS.name: Blessed
AGENT_CONDITIONS.description: Touched by divine favor. Fortune bends in their direction.

AGENT_CONDITIONS.name: Cursed
AGENT_CONDITIONS.description: Marked by malign forces. Misfortune clings to every endeavor.

AGENT_CONDITIONS.name: Exhausted
AGENT_CONDITIONS.description: Pushed beyond their limits. Everything takes more effort.

AGENT_CONDITIONS.name: Grieving
AGENT_CONDITIONS.description: Carrying a loss. Attention goes where the absence is, not where the work is.

AGENT_CONDITIONS.name: Shaken
AGENT_CONDITIONS.description: Their own judgement is the thing they trust least right now.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Fractured Arm
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A broken bone limits striking power and grip strength.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Gashed Leg
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Deep laceration impairs movement and endurance.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Cracked Ribs
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Breathing hurts. Fighting hurts more.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Bruised Knuckles
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Swollen hands make delicate work impossible.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Deep Stab Wound
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Internal damage that risks infection and limits exertion.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Shattered Shield Arm
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: The arm that blocks can no longer bear weight.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Blinded Eye
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Lost depth perception impairs awareness and aim.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Spine Wound
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Catastrophic injury to the back. Movement and combat severely impaired.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Dawn-Kissed
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A faint warmth lingers, granting minor divine favor.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Healer's Touch
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Hands carry a soothing warmth that eases pain.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Fortune-Marked
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Luck bends slightly in your direction.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Saint's Ward
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A protective aura that dulls hostile intent nearby.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Earthblood Vigor
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Vitality drawn from the land itself. Wounds close faster, muscles ache less.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: The Anointing
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Marked by divine purpose. Perception and faith burn bright.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Ill Luck
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Misfortune clings like smoke. Commerce and stealth suffer.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Nightmares
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Restless sleep erodes composure and empathy.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Tonguebound
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Cannot speak truths about a particular subject. Social reach impaired.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Mark of Debt
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A supernatural debt that drains material fortune.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Watch Scrutiny
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: The checkpoint remembers your face. Inspections linger, questions multiply, and every small irregularity now feels one witness away from becoming a problem.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: The Hollow
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Something essential has been taken. Joy, purpose, or identity — something is missing.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Road Fever
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A common illness from exposure and bad water.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Gut Rot
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Contaminated food or water. Debilitating cramps and weakness.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Greyscale
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Skin hardens and cracks. Mobility and appearance degrade.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: The Wasting
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A supernatural consumption that devours vitality and thins the boundary to death.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Fey-Touched
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Brief exposure to the otherworld leaves lingering perception.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Death-Marked
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Survived something that should have killed. The shadow world notices.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Void-Scarred
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Touched by the space between worlds. Reality sits uneasy around you.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Gale-Touched
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A divine gift of speed — the body moves before the mind decides.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Temporal Anchor
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Time flows around you like water around a stone. Your blessings linger.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Leaden Limbs
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A sluggishness in the bones. Movement becomes a negotiation with gravity.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Time-Eaten
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Something has bitten a piece from your timeline. Moments vanish without memory.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: The Red Divide
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: A berserker trance. The world slows, the body quickens, reason dims.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Fortune-Kissed
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Fate bends gently toward the bearer. Misfortune slides past like rain off wax.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Null-Touched
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: Something has scoured the magic from your blood. Spells slide off you. So do blessings.

REWARD_CONDITIONS.name: Warded Ground
REWARD_CONDITIONS.description: The earth itself remembers your claim. Trespassers feel the boundary in their bones.

REACH_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.iron: Of force and arms — a thing meant for the fight, or marked by one.
REACH_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.gold: Of trade and worth — a thing bought, bartered, or counted.
REACH_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.shadow: Of stealth and secrets — a thing that keeps quiet, or keeps something quiet.
REACH_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.veil: Of the unseen — a thing touched by what lies behind the world.
REACH_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.heart: Of bonds and feeling — a thing that moves people, or is moved by them.
REACH_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.eye: Of watching and knowing — a thing that sees further than it should.
REACH_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.stone: Of craft and endurance — a thing built to last, or built to build.
REACH_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.star: Of lore and the far pattern — a thing that answers to what is written above.

SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.chaos: Sworn to Chaos — unruly, and apt to become something it was not.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.order: Sworn to Order — it holds its shape, and holds others to theirs.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.light: Sworn to Light — it reveals, warms, and is hard to hide behind.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.darkness: Sworn to Darkness — it conceals, and asks nothing about what it hides.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.force: Of Force — it pushes, strikes, or refuses to be moved.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.matter: Of Matter — solid, worked, and stubbornly itself.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.energy: Of Energy — it burns, quickens, or spends itself to act.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.life: Of Life — it grows, heals, or wants to keep growing.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.mind: Of Mind — it thinks, remembers, or leans on the thoughts of others.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.spirit: Of Spirit — it answers to devotion rather than to hands.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.time: Of Time — it wears, waits, or keeps a reckoning of its own.
SPHERE_TAG_DESCRIPTIONS.entropy: Of Entropy — it unmakes, and is patient about it.

trait.artifact.storied: has seen a thing or two
trait.artifact.cursed: the harm comes with the having
